# L2 Global Technologies

> L2 Global Technologies Ltd. is an IT integration consultancy founded in 2014, headquartered in the UK, delivering Salesforce, SAP, MuleSoft, AWS, Oracle, data science and web development services to businesses across the UK, USA, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar and India. 182+ projects delivered, 45+ certified experts.

## Company facts

- Founded: 2014
- Headquarters: Gloucester, England, United Kingdom (registered in England & Wales)
- Also serving: USA (Texas), UAE (Dubai), Saudi Arabia, Qatar, India (Vijayawada, Bengaluru)
- Projects delivered: 182+
- Team size: 45+ certified IT experts
- Website: https://l2global.in
- Contact email: contactus@l2global.in
- Phone (UK): +44 7442 586325
- Phone (India): +91 90000 14701

## Services

- [Salesforce Agentforce AI](https://l2global.in/services/agentforce-ai): Autonomous AI agent implementation for sales and service on the Salesforce platform.
- [SAP Joule AI](https://l2global.in/services/sap-ai): Generative AI implementation embedded across SAP S/4HANA and SAP BTP.
- [SAP S/4HANA & RISE with SAP](https://l2global.in/services/sap): SAP ECC to S/4HANA migration and RISE with SAP cloud transition.
- [Salesforce Implementation & Consulting](https://l2global.in/services/salesforce-services): Salesforce implementation, customisation and managed support.
- [Salesforce CRM Consulting](https://l2global.in/services/crm-consulting): CRM strategy and Salesforce consulting services.
- [SAP & Salesforce Integration](https://l2global.in/services/sap-link-by-salesforce): Real-time integration between SAP and Salesforce.
- [MuleSoft Integration Services](https://l2global.in/services/mulesoft): MuleSoft Anypoint Platform integration.
- [API Integration Services](https://l2global.in/services/api-integration): Enterprise API design, development and integration.
- [AWS Cloud Migration & DevOps](https://l2global.in/services/aws-cloud-services): AWS cloud migration, architecture and DevOps.
- [Oracle Managed Services](https://l2global.in/services/oracle-managed-services): 24/7 Oracle DBA and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure management.
- [Data Science & Machine Learning](https://l2global.in/services/data-science): Machine learning, generative AI and BI dashboards.
- [Web Development Services](https://l2global.in/services/web-development): Fixed-price B2B website design and development.
